title: 第444章 离谱的诈骗团伙第450章 夜魇的机缘到了
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 黄金虎的咆哮声在大堂内回荡着。
一众大帝分身瞠目结舌，全场死寂，所有目光全都落在了天机老人的脸上。
老者的脸色已经阴沉得能滴出水来。
仙风道骨的气质全无。
青铜罗盘凭空浮现在其掌心。
罗盘上的指针疯狂旋转，整座通天城猛烈震荡，周遭空间扭曲崩塌，爆碎出一条条骇人的空间裂缝。
大堂内，空间如同一张被剪刀裁满口子的白纸。
白纸上的豁口越来越多…越来越多……下一瞬，张白纸彻底报废，七零八落。
大堂内的空间碎尽，化为一个恐怖黑洞，一众大帝分身瞬间陷入黑洞后的虚无之地。
青铜罗盘的指针猛然旋停，锋利的指针死死指向黄金虎！
一股天道杀机将后者死死锁定！！
“呦呵，老畜生，你还想动手？”黄金虎阴森着脸冷笑。
其背后，一尊黄金神山虚影陡然浮现。
滔天帝威如风暴般卷向整片虚无之地，青铜罗盘猛地一颤，指针瞬间被震歪了方向……
“黄金虎，你欺人太甚。”天机老人低垂着眸子，整个人阴沉的似要吞人。
黄金虎冷笑，“软柿子，老子就欺负你了又能如何？”
“老子还是那句话，一巴掌外加10亿赔偿金，你若掏不出来，那你个老畜生就可以等死了。”
“你的天机星篆山，老子也会一手抹去！”
天机老人的胸口起伏着。
他的视线冷视向四面八方，这些过往与他交好的大帝，此刻竟无一人开口帮他说话。
他整个人怒意滔天。
“黄金虎，本帝不是你的对手，但你想杀本帝也是做梦！”
“你若敢对天机星篆山出手，那本帝便找你黄金家族小辈泄火！本帝会将你黄金家族血脉屠尽，让你个老东西成孤家寡人！！”
“天机，你敢！！”黄金虎暴怒。
“呵呵，你试试不就知道本帝敢不敢了？你若想不死不休，那本帝舍命陪你！”
二人剑拔弩张，一触即发。
“够了，都闭嘴。”宁天策不耐烦的打断。
目光冷冷的扫过二人。
“你们被骗的灵石若不想找回来了，那就继续吵！滚回你们自己的家族去吵！别碍本帝的眼！！”
现场顿时安静了下来。
黄金虎的眼眸深处，闪过一抹隐晦的懵逼之色。
他的脑海中，一道同样懵逼的苍老声音响了起来。
“虎哥，什么情况？宁天策突然出来打圆场，你跟他提前商量好的？”
“商量个屁！这腹黑货和小秦有些关系，多半看出了咱俩是想借演戏摘除那群蠢货的怀疑，他这一开口，倒是把他自己也顺便摘了个干净。”
content_en:
The roar of the golden tiger echoed in the lobby.
All the clones of the Great Emperor were dumbfounded, and the whole place was completely silent. All eyes fell on the face of Old Man Tianji.
The old man's face was so gloomy that water could drip from his face.
There is no celestial spirit at all.
Buzz! ! !
A bronze compass appeared out of thin air in his palm.
The pointer on the compass rotated crazily, the entire Tongtian City shook violently, and the surrounding space twisted and collapsed, exploding into terrifying space cracks.
In the lobby, the space is like a piece of white paper filled with scissors.
There were more and more gaps on the white paper... more and more... In the next moment, the white paper was completely scrapped and fell into pieces.
boom! !
The space in the lobby was shattered and turned into a terrifying black hole. All the clones of the Great Emperor instantly fell into the void behind the black hole.
The pointer of the bronze compass suddenly stopped spinning, and the sharp pointer pointed at the golden tiger!
A murderous intention from heaven locked the latter tightly! !
"Hey, old beast, you still want to take action?" Golden Tiger sneered sinisterly.
boom! ! !
Behind it, the shadow of a golden sacred mountain suddenly appeared.
The monstrous imperial power rolled towards the entire land of nothingness like a storm. The bronze compass trembled suddenly, and the pointer was instantly deflected...
"Golden Tiger, you are going too far." Old Man Tianji lowered his eyes, his whole body was so gloomy that he seemed to be swallowing others.
Golden Tiger sneered, "You are a soft persimmon, so what if I bully you?"
"I'm still saying the same thing, a slap plus 1 billion in compensation. If you can't pay it, then you can just wait for death, you old beast."
"I will also erase your Tianji Xingzhuan Mountain with one hand!"
Old Man Tianji's chest heaved.
He looked coldly in all directions. None of the great emperors who had been friends with him in the past spoke up for him at the moment.
His whole body was filled with rage.
"Golden Tiger, I am no match for you, but even if you want to kill me, it is just a dream!"
"If you dare to take action against Tianji Xingzhuan Mountain, then I will vent my anger on you, the junior member of the Golden Family! I will slaughter all the blood of your Golden Family and leave you, an old man, alone!!"
"Tianji, how dare you!!" Golden Tiger was furious.
"Haha, don't you try it and you will know whether I dare or not? If you want to fight to the death, then I will risk my life to accompany you!"
The two of them were at war with each other and were about to explode.
"That's enough, shut up." Ning Tiance interrupted impatiently.
His eyes swept over the two of them coldly.
"If you don't want to get your deceived spirit stone back, then continue to argue! Go back to your own family and argue! Don't get in the eyes of this emperor!!"
The scene suddenly became quiet.
A hint of confusion flashed through the depths of Golden Tiger's eyes.
In his mind, an equally confused old voice sounded.
"Brother Hu, what's going on? Ning Tiance suddenly came out to smooth things over. Did you discuss it with him in advance?"
"It's nothing to discuss! This scheming guy has something to do with Xiao Qin. He probably figured out that we were trying to use acting to dispel the suspicion of those idiots. His opening his mouth actually dispelled his own suspicions."
title_en: Chapter 444: The Outrageous Fraud Group Chapter 450: The Nightmare’s Opportunity Has Come
